item.name: Products

request.description:
Create a new product.

**Ownership (at least one required):**
- vendor_id: Optional - Vendor ID for marketplace products
- store_id: Optional - Store ID for store products
- venue_id: Optional - Venue ID for POS/venue products

**Compound Products:**
- is_compound: Set to true for products made from ingredients
- ingredients: Array of ingredient objects with:
  - ingredient_type: "STOCK_ITEM", "PRODUCT", "PRODUCT_VARIANT", or "HARDWARE"
  - ingredient_id: ID of the stock item, product, variant, or hardware
  - quantity_required: Amount needed per product unit
  - is_consumed: Whether consumed when product is sold (default: true)

**Backward Compatible:** vendor_id and store_id are now optional to support venue-only products.

request.description:
Update a product.

**Compound Products:**
- is_compound: Set to true for products made from ingredients
- ingredients: Array of ingredient objects (replaces existing ingredients):
  - ingredient_type: "STOCK_ITEM", "PRODUCT", "PRODUCT_VARIANT", or "HARDWARE"
  - ingredient_id: ID of the stock item, product, variant, or hardware
  - quantity_required: Amount needed per product unit
  - is_consumed: Whether consumed when product is sold (default: true)

Get products that are below their low stock threshold.

**Query Parameters:**
- skip: Pagination offset (default: 0)
- limit: Max results (default: 50)

Returns products where inventory_quantity < low_stock_threshold.
Use this for inventory alerts and reordering.

Update product inventory/stock levels.

**Request Body:**
- inventory_quantity: New stock level
- variant_id: Optional - Update specific variant
- base_price: Optional - Update base price
- sale_price: Optional - Update sale price

Triggers low_stock alerts if quantity falls below threshold.

item.description: Product management including inventory/stock. Use PUT /products/{id}/inventory to update stock levels. GET /products/low-stock returns products below threshold.

item.name: Inventory

request.description:
Get products that are below their low stock threshold.

**Query Parameters:**
- skip: Pagination offset (default: 0)
- limit: Max results (default: 50)
- threshold: Override default threshold

Returns products where inventory_quantity < low_stock_threshold.
Use this for inventory alerts and reordering.

Update product inventory/stock levels.

**Request Body:**
- inventory_quantity: New stock level (required)
- variant_id: Optional - Update specific variant
- reason: Optional - Reason for adjustment

Triggers low_stock alerts if quantity falls below threshold.

Get stock adjustment history for a product.

**Query Parameters:**
- start_date: Start of date range
- end_date: End of date range

Returns list of stock adjustments with reasons and timestamps.

Update stock levels for multiple products at once.

**Request Body:**
Array of objects with:
- product_id: Product to update
- inventory_quantity: New stock level
- variant_id: Optional variant

Useful for inventory counts and bulk restocking.

item.description:
Stock and inventory management APIs.

**Features:**
- Track stock levels across products and variants
- Low stock alerts and thresholds
- Stock adjustments and audits
- Inventory reports

item.name: Stock Items

request.description:
Create a new stock item (ingredient). Venue assignment is optional.

**Example:** Potatoes, Onions, Cooking Oil

**Units:** KG, G, L, ML, UNIT, PIECE

List stock items.

**Query Parameters:**
- venue_id: Optional - Filter by venue
- station_id: Optional - Filter by station
- category: Optional - Filter by category
- low_stock_only: Optional - Only show items below threshold
- unassigned_only: Optional - Only show items not assigned to any venue
Assign a stock item to a venue or station. Stock items can be created without venue and assigned later.
Update stock level (restock or adjustment). Creates a transaction record for audit trail.
Add quantity to a stock item. Records a RESTOCK transaction.

Create a dependency for a compound product.

**Example:** French Fries depends on:
- Stock Item: Potatoes (0.3 KG) - consumed
- Hardware: Deep Fryer (1 unit) - not consumed, just used
Get all dependencies for a compound product.
Check if a compound product can be made with current stock.

item.description:
Stock items are raw ingredients (potatoes, onions, etc.) used to create compound products.

**Compound Products:**
- Products that depend on stock items, hardware, or other products
- When marked READY, dependencies are automatically consumed

**Features:**
- Create stock items without venue assignment (assign later)
- Track ingredient inventory per venue
- Set low stock thresholds
- Create product dependencies for compound products
- Automatic consumption when items are prepared

item.name: Staff

query.description: Filter by manager status (optional). VALUES: true, false

item.description: Staff management for POS service. Staff can be managers (is_manager=true) or regular staff. Roles are created on-demand in auth-service. Use PUT /staff/{id} to assign/remove venues/stations (include in venue_ids/station_ids arrays) or deactivate (set is_active=false).

item.name: Service Carts

request.description:
Create a new service cart for in-venue ordering.

**Required:**
- venue_id: Where the cart is being created
- staff_id: Staff member creating the cart

**Optional:**
- cart_name: Display name (e.g., "Table 5")
- floor_plan_item_ids: Table/seat identifiers
- notes: General cart notes
- items: Initial items (can add later via POST /items)

**Cart starts in OPEN status** - Add items, then set status=SUBMITTED to send to stations.

List all service carts for a venue.

**Query Parameters:**
- venue_id (required): Filter by venue
- skip: Pagination offset (default: 0)
- limit: Max results (default: 20)

Returns carts sorted by created_at descending.

Get a single service cart by ID.

Returns cart with all items, their statuses, and assigned stations.

Update cart details or submit for processing.

**Updatable Fields:**
- cart_name: Display name
- notes: General notes
- status: Set to SUBMITTED to send orders to stations

**Status Transitions:**
- OPEN → SUBMITTED (sends items to stations)
- SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (if not yet processed)

Note: Items are managed via separate /items endpoints.

Add an item to an OPEN cart.

**SIMPLIFIED PAYLOAD** - Only provide:
- product_id (required)
- quantity (required)
- notes (optional) - Special instructions
- metadata (optional) - Custom data like modifiers
- station_override (optional) - Override auto-routing

The system will:
1. Fetch product details (name, price) from catalog
2. Validate product availability
3. Check stock levels
4. Auto-route to least loaded station
5. Assign hardware if product requires it

Update a cart item's status.

**Item Status Flow:**
PENDING → IN_PROGRESS → READY → SERVED

Use this when:
- Station accepts order: IN_PROGRESS
- Item prepared: READY (triggers stock consumption & hardware assignment)
- Item served to customer: SERVED
Remove an item from an OPEN cart.
Delete a service cart. Only OPEN or CANCELLED carts can be deleted.

item.description: Service cart management for venue orders. Carts track items, route to stations, and integrate with marketplace for checkout.

**Query Parameters:**
- start_date: Start of date range (YYYY-MM-DD)
- end_date: End of date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

Returns total sales, items sold, and order count per venue.

Get sales report grouped by station.

**Query Parameters:**
- venue_id: Filter by venue
- start_date: Start of date range
- end_date: End of date range

Returns items processed, revenue, and average processing time per station.

Get top selling items across all venues.

**Query Parameters:**
- venue_id: Optional - Filter by venue
- limit: Number of items to return (default: 10)

Returns ranked list of products by quantity sold.

Get staff performance metrics.

**Query Parameters:**
- venue_id: Optional - Filter by venue
- start_date: Start of date range
- end_date: End of date range

Returns orders processed, items served, average time per order per staff member.
